welcome.title: Welcome to Mapcess
welcome.tip: A quick tour of the four most common things people report — ramps, sidewalks, elevators, and doors — and how to file your first report in under a minute.

ramps.title: Ramps
ramps.bullet2: Clear width ≥ 100 cm — room for a walker + helper
ramps.bullet3: Handrails on both sides at 90 cm (extra rail at 70 cm for shorter users)
ramps.bullet4: Tactile warning strip at the top and bottom of the ramp

sidewalks.title: Sidewalks
sidewalks.bullet1: Clear width ≥ 150 cm — wheelchairs need to pass each other
sidewalks.bullet2: Overhead clearance ≥ 220 cm — no low branches or signs
sidewalks.bullet3: Contrasting strip along the curb edge so it's visible against the road

elevators.title: Elevators
elevators.bullet1: Door clear width ≥ 90 cm when fully open
elevators.bullet2: Braille labels on every button and voice announcement
elevators.bullet3: Visual floor display + flashing emergency alarm

doors.title: Doors
doors.bullet1: Clear width ≥ 90 cm when fully open
doors.bullet2: Lever handle (not a knob) — easier with weak grip
doors.bullet3: Glass panels marked with contrasting bands at eye level

howTo.title: How to file a report
howTo.tip: Once five neighbours agree, your report becomes verified and starts shaping accessible routes for everyone.

login.heroDescription: Your reports help people with mobility challenges find accessible routes, ramps, and barrier-free paths in their neighbourhood.
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to continue your civic contribution.
